def symvals(g,i,j):
    n=len(g)
    return [g[i][j],g[n-1-i][n-1-j],g[i][n-1-j],g[n-1-i][j],g[j][i],g[n-1-j][n-1-i],g[j][n-1-i],g[n-1-j][i]]
def fix(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; n=len(g)
    for _ in range(6):
        changed=False
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
